purpose: Audit whether the V29R1 issuer-title veto removes economically distinct failures or merely reshuffles a capacity-constrained portfolio.

review_corpus.vetoed: all 60 V29R1 development vetoes, including rows without complete outcomes
review_corpus.kept_losers: all V29R1 development portfolio-accepted trades with net_return below zero
review_corpus.kept_winners: nearest positive-return observations to the 25th, 50th and 75th percentile within each signal year

title_buckets.CLEAR_HIGH_RISK_VETO: At least one title-only OPEN family is regulatory investigation, delisting warning, illegal guarantee or issuer bank-account freeze.
title_buckets.SUSPECTED_ROUTINE_OCCUPANCY_TITLE_FALSE_: Only the fund-misappropriation family matched, while every title reads like a recurring independent-director, audit or special-report heading and no assertive adverse token appears.
title_buckets.OTHER_FUND_OCCUPANCY_VETO: A fund-occupancy title that cannot be safely called routine from the title alone.
title_buckets.guardrail: These are anatomy labels, not a replacement classifier and not evidence about document contents. Ambiguity remains fail-closed in the frozen V29R1 selector.

chart_contract.daily_window: signal minus 120 through signal plus 120 trading sessions, physically capped at 2021-12-31
chart_contract.price: causal coordinate OHLC with invalid rows omitted; frozen gap L/U, prior-only 20-session support/resistance and 120-session extrema
chart_contract.chip: latest strict CY-009 state whose available_at is no later than each daily decision_at; p10/p50/p90 are never normalized or clipped
chart_contract.inventory: raw pre-gap float-turnover mass by frozen z_bin, with z=(price-L)/W
chart_contract.market_industry: PIT signal-date industry and hard-valid CY-006 cross-sectional median daily returns, normalized only as plotted cumulative-return indices
chart_contract.intraday: hard-valid CY-008 six 5-minute execution windows on signal and entry dates; no same-bar fill inference
chart_contract.lifecycle: signal, first legal T+1 entry and frozen exit are annotated when a complete outcome exists

interpretation_guards: Post-signal candles and outcomes are labels for anatomy and never signal-time predictors.
A higher conditional mean after deletions is not itself proof that issuer risk predicts losses.
Capacity replacement and crowded entry dates must be separated from event-level selection effect.
No threshold search, title-rule edit, stop edit or validation rescue is authorized by this diagnostic.
